reason: I've been burned by AI messing up finance and math formulas before, so a verbatim slide citation alone doesn't prove the applied formula-remix questions or AI debriefs actually calculate things right. If I still have to double-check every formula and step against my slides anyway, I'm not paying 69,000 VND for a cram pass in a normal week.
objection: Linking back to my slide page doesn't stop the tool from misreading subscripts and fractions out of a PDF or making calculation mistakes inside applied formula-remix problems and Socratic explanations. Getting a refund later won't give me back the hours I wasted late at night before an exam if I study a broken step.
would_change_my_mind: Testing the free starter deck on my hardest finance or calculus PDF right before finals and seeing every equation, subscript, and step-by-step remix calculation come out 100% accurate with exact slide screenshots.
